package.name: san_description
package.description:
SAN v1.5 — Combat robot URDF/xacro description package.
Ported and adapted from skyhunter_description (Limon code). Provides a complete xacro-based robot model including: - chassis + tracks - 360° pan-tilt gimbal (SDD §8) - EO + thermal dual-camera (IMX678) - LiDAR (Robosense E1) - IMU - GPS / RTK antenna - 5.56 mm rifle mount
Used by san_sim_gazebo for simulation spawn, and (with HW drivers) for real robot description in TF.
